hints.title: Single Machine Rule
hints.text: All created alloys must be produced using the exact same machine.

hints.title: Monotonic Feasibility
hints.text: For a fixed machine, the budget required to create x alloys increases monotonically with x.

hints.title: Binary Search on Answer
hints.text: For each of the k machines, binary search on target alloys from 0 to 10^9, checking whether required cost <= budget.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear search on number of alloys is too slow given high budgets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize monotonicity and apply binary search over each machine independently.
